# Custom Copilot Instructions: Single Block Plugin

Use this file to maintain custom instructions for Copilot or contributors.

- Follow [LightSpeed coding standards](https://github.com/lightspeedwp/.github/blob/master/.github/instructions/coding-standards.instructions.md)
- Reference all prompts/instructions from this folder in setup and documentation.
- All blocks must support i18n and accessibility.

See [repo-template.md](./repo-template.md) for structure and standards.
